_about: Claude plan and Claude Code usage-limit facts for the Kite Pulse guides. Every fact carries the exact sentence it was taken from and its source page. Read by /claude-code-usage-limits (copied into the prototype's PLAN_FACTS on the checked date) and meant for /plan-headroom and /ai-coding-assistant-pricing. Anthropic's help pages show no calendar dates ('Updated over a week ago'), so `checked` is the date a person read them. Re-check monthly: limits change.
not_published_by_anthropic: Fixed message, token or hour counts per plan: limits are stated as relative sizes and reset rules only

two_limits.quote: Paid plans have two types of usage limits: a session limit that resets every five hours, and weekly limits that reset once every week.

shared.quote: These limits are shared across Claude and Claude Code, meaning all activity in both tools counts against the same limits.

weekly_reset_time.quote: The weekly limit resets at a fixed time each week that is assigned to your account.

team_rolling.quote: On Claude for Teams and Enterprise plans, each member's Claude Code usage draws from a per-seat allowance that resets on a rolling five-hour window and a weekly window.

warnings.quote: To help you monitor your usage, you'll see warning messages as you approach any limit.

other_caps.quote: we may limit your usage in other ways, such as weekly and monthly caps or model and feature usage, at our discretion.

factors.quote: the length and complexity of your conversations, the features you use, which Claude model you're chatting with, and the effort level you've selected

session_shared_across_models.quote: a seat-based usage window on a subscription plan, shared across all models, so the developer can't restore access by switching models with `/model`.

model_limit_switch.quote: After the model-specific "You've hit your Opus limit" or "You've hit your Sonnet limit" message, switching to a model outside that family with `/model` does keep the developer working.

price.quote: The Pro plan is available for $20 per month (US), with pricing in your local currency where supported.

size.text: More usage per session than Free
size.quote: More usage per session than the Free plan.

weekly.quote: Pro plans also have a weekly usage limit that applies across all models.

wrap_up.quote: On the Pro plan, it applies up to once per weekly usage period.

past_limit.quote: Consider upgrading to the Max 5x plan if you consistently hit limits and need more capacity for larger repositories.

size.quote: five times the Pro plan's per-session usage allowance

weekly.quote: Max plans also have a weekly usage limit that applies across all models.

model_weekly.quote: Max plans also have a separate weekly limit for Fable.

wrap_up.quote: On the Max plan, it can apply each time you reach a five-hour session limit, within your weekly limit.

size.text: Depends on seat tier (Standard or Premium)
size.quote: Premium seats offer more usage for team members with heavier workloads.

past_limit.quote: you can enable usage credits to allow team members to continue working

size.quote: there are no per-seat usage limits.

billing.quote: On the Console and on cloud providers, usage is billed per token to your organization.

rate_limits.quote: Claude Code traffic in this workspace counts toward your organization's overall API rate limits.

env_key.quote: If you have an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable set on your system, Claude Code will use this API key for authentication instead of your Claude subscription.

wrap_up.quote: Claude Code may keep working briefly so it can finish the step in progress.
This wrap-up allowance is small and capped, and the usage counts toward your weekly limit.
